APPROVE exact candidate 1e5df7aeaf6b6624764c6ca5de48119d72f91ff5.

Reviewed cumulative diff from base adf58cad3dc419d6a383355cf0479e846b5175dd and successor delta from 120e5202148e7a8703625f00474cc310f2d7ac40. Only tools/premerge-check.sh and tools/premerge-check-test.sh are in scope; the successor delta changes the court only.

Independent exact-SHA archive: /private/tmp/storymodel-premerge-review.JeNHiv.
- bash tools/premerge-check-test.sh: pass
- bash -n on checker and court: pass
- git diff --check base..candidate: pass
- author receipt SHA-256 matches 0fae5586e616744475451b9d6a05013335d88ecb1c9800a9cdb66d0262955569
- receipt reports shell court, syntax, diff, and four checks green.

The successor now directly courts the two omissions from my prior blocks: empty candidate_id fails closed, and a valid landed row beside a malformed identity row rejects the entire snapshot. I independently changed the production invalid-row branch from raise to continue. The committed court exited 1 at the exact mixed-row case because the mutated checker falsely passed and reconciled the valid row. The precise skip-malformed-row mutation is therefore killed.

The parser continues to accept only a unique landed or landed_out_of_band row for a first-parent commit. Pending, abandoned, superseded, unknown, missing phase, absent or empty identity, duplicate OID, command failure, malformed JSON, and contradictory landability stay fail-closed. No edits to candidate source, no landing authorization, and no scope expansion.
